title: dg branch share --json
description: A members-only branch shared, as it is now, with people who are not members (a key letter only they and you open; later pushes are not shared).

commits.description: Commits on the branch beyond the public branches.

extraCommits.description: Commits the shared packs hold that are not on the branch (stored with its commits by another members-only branch or an earlier push).

packs.description: How many stored members-only packs the share opens.

to.description: The identity ids it was shared with (you are always a recipient too).
